messages:
elaine (sales): Customer running a POC hitting 403s intermittently when hitting /v1/generate. Says keys were provided from the dashboard yesterday. Can ping eng help?
shane (sales-eng): thanks for flagging — can you paste the exact error and a minimal curl?
elaine (sales): they sent this snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED' \
  -H 'X-Org-Id: org-acme-123' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-8k","input":"hello"}'
```
and they see:
```
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"org id mismatch: token bound to org org-acme, request org header org-acme-qa"}}
```
elaine (sales): they also reported spikes of rate limit 429s during load tests, likely separate.
shane (sales-eng): ok two things: 1) the 403 says token org binding mismatches the `X-Org-Id` header the client is sending (common for copied test headers). 2) the 429s may be because their trial quota is low — we can check usage & bump for the demo.
maria (eng-oncall): pinging logs for that key now — @devops-bot can you fetch recent auth logs for sk-prod-REDACTED?
devops-bot: fetching auth logs for token ending in -REDACTED... 
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z AUTH FAIL token=sk-prod-REDACTED request_org=org-acme-qa token_org=org-acme reason=org_mismatch
2026-03-18T14:02:55Z AUTH SUCCESS token=sk-prod-REDACTED request_org=org-acme token_org=org-acme
2026-03-18T14:05:02Z RATE_LIMIT token=sk-prod-REDACTED region=us-west-2 reqs=120 window=60s limit=100
```
shane (sales-eng): logs confirm both issues. For the org mismatch: customer likely has two environments (acme vs acme-qa) and copied token between them. Ask them to either remove `X-Org-Id` header (we infer org from token) or use the token bound to that org.
elaine (sales): customer says they rely on explicit `X-Org-Id` because they proxy requests — they expected tokens to be cross-bound. Any workaround?
maria (eng-oncall): short term: reissue a token bound to `org-acme-qa` and give them that for the QA environment. Longer term: if they want a token usable across multiple orgs we need an entitlement change (security/whitelabel) — not recommended for multitenant isolation.
shane (sales-eng): I can re-provision a QA-scoped key from the console for the demo. Also re: 429s — we can temporarily raise demo quota to 500rps for 30m while they load test. Elaine, want me to authorize that?
elaine (sales): yes please, they'll do a 10min stress test at 15:30 PT.
maria (eng-oncall): done — raised demo quota and created temp token bound to org-acme-qa. Token id ends with -TMPQA. I posted it to the customer's secure chat.
elaine (sales): they validated request now works, 200s returning. :tada:
customer (via DM to elaine): thanks — 200s ✅, load test hit 480rps, occasional 503 when they exceeded burst concurrency, but overall perf looks good.
shane (sales-eng): quick note for runbook: if you see `org id mismatch` errors, check `request_org` vs `token_org` in auth logs and confirm header vs token binding. For rate limits, check per-key window and apply temporary bump for demos. I'll add this to the presales checklist.
elaine (sales): great, closing the loop with the customer now. thanks all :pray:
